title: The Excitation Conditions of CN in TW Hya
question: Is CN emission in the TW Hya disk in LTE, and what excitation temperatures, kinetic temperatures and densities, and hence emitting regions, does it trace across the N=1-0, 2-1 and 3-2 transitions?

data.arrays: Band 3: 42 antennas; Band 6: 34 antennas; Band 7: 45 antennas

what.value: CN line frequencies, Einstein A, degeneracies, dipole strengths

evidence.quote: The line frequencies, Einstein A coefficients, upper state degeneracies and dipole strengths were taken from the CDMS

what.value: CN-H2 collisional rates including hyperfine structure, from LAMDA

evidence.quote: with the latest CN collisional rates which include hyperfine structure (cite: Kalugina_Lique_2015), obtained from the LAMDA database

what.value: TW Hya physical structure model for densities and temperatures

evidence.quote: Based on the physical structure model from (cite: Qi_ea_2013), this is achieved at heights of $z\,/\,r \gtrsim 0.2$.

recipe.method: tclean with Keplerian mask and Briggs weighting, per band

recipe.goal: Stack spectra and measure rotation/stellar mass and fluxes
recipe.method: Annuli of beam/4 width; Gaussian-process rotation curve; Keplerian fit; shift and stack; integrate over 1.5 km/s window; matched filter check
key_parameters: inclination 6.5 deg, PA 151 deg; 1.5 km/s window; 40 m/s binning

recipe.method: Two offset Gaussians with shared width and independent amplitudes
Isothermal slab model with {Tex, dV, tau0} per fine-structure group in 0.1" annuli, full Planck function, convolved with spectral response
key_parameters: emcee: walkers = 2x free parameters, 2000 burn-in + 10000 steps; Nelder-Mead start
assumptions: shared Tex within group; Gaussian profiles; optical depths summed

recipe.method: Forward model beam-broadened dV profile with broken power-law Tkin(r), compare to observed dV
key_parameters: 12 walkers, 2000 burn-in + 2000 steps; fit 0.3"-3.0"; pivot at 1"
assumptions: purely thermal broadening, mu_CN=26, Mstar=0.65 Msun, i=6.8 deg

recipe.method: Compute Tex scatter within fine-structure groups versus H2 density
key_parameters: Tkin=24 K, N(CN)=1e14 cm^-2, thermalised linewidth

evidence.quote: 24 hyperfine transitions are detected out of the 30
334 kHz for the 340.247770 GHz components and 295 kHz for the 340.035408 GHz components
334 kHz for the 340.247770 GHz components and 295 kHz for the 340.035408 GHz components

not_stated_but_needed: Line-free channels and continuum subtraction details
Cell and image size, multiscale scales
Spectral averaging details (8 and 16 channels stated only in appendix)
Inclination 6.8 vs 6.5 deg inconsistency between uses
Priors on tau0 and Tkin parameters
Observing configuration details of Band 7 flux calibration
score_reason: Data are public and the method is well described with MCMC settings, but imaging and calibration details are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, numeric Tex/Tkin results, and a mostly complete recipe.
